m: गै cl. 1. P. गायति, rarely Ā. ˚ते (1. sg. गाये [RV. viii, 46, 17] & गायिषे [RV. vii, 96, 1] Lāṭy.; MBh. &c.), exceptionally cl. 2. गाति (MBh. iii, 15850; xii, 10299 : cl. 3. P. जिगाति, Dhātup. xxii, 20; perf. जगौ, AitBr. &c.; aor. अगासीत्; Prec. गेयात्, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 67; pr. p. P. गायत्, RV. &c.; ind.p. गीत्वा [with prep. -गाय (Pāṇ. vi, 4, 69), AitBr., or -गीय, ŚBr. &c.]; inf. गातुम्), to sing, speak or recite in a singing manner, sing to (dat. RV.), praise in song (with acc.), relate in metrical language, RV.; AV. &c.; to sing before (acc.), Kathās. i, 53 : Pass. गीयते (p. ˚यमान), to be sung or praised in song, RV. &c.; to be called, MBh. i, 4329; Kum. ii, 5; Kathās. xci (perf. जगे), &c.: Caus. गापयति (Pot. 3. pl. गाययेयुर्, JaimUp.), to cause to sing or praise in song, Lāṭy.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Ragh.; BhP. &c.: Intens. जेगीयते (Pāṇ. vi, 4, 66), to sing, MBh. xii, 12200; to be sung or praised in song, VarBṛS. xix, 18; Daś. i, 6; to be asserted obstinately, Sarvad. iii, 224; xii, 1;
गै [cf. 3. गा; cf. also Lith. zaidziu.]
a: गै — {c1c} P. (गायति, जगौ, अगासीत्, गास्यति, गातुं, गीत) 1 To sing, sing a song; अहो साधु रेभिलेन गीतं Mk. 3; ग्रीष्मसमयमधिकृत्य गीयतां Ś. 1; Ms. 4. 64; 9. 42. --2 To speak or recite in a singing tone. --3 To relate, declare, tell (especially in metrical language); गीतश्चायमर्थोंगिरसा Māl. 2. --4 To describe, relate or celebrate in song; चारणद्वंद्वगीतः Ś. 2. 14, प्रभवस्तस्य गीयते Ku. 2. 5. --Caus. (गापयति-ते) To cause to sing or praise in song; जयोदाहरणं बाह्वोर्गापयामास किन्नरान् R. 4. 78, 15. 33.
